units.source_text: 浮舟看见薰大将信中虽不明言而隐约表示已有所知，心中更添恐惧。

en.t: When Ukifune saw that Kaoru's letter, though not saying so plainly, hinted that he already knew something, her fear grew even greater.

units.source_text: 她想：“此身终于要做出荒唐可耻的事情来了！”

en.t: She thought, "At last I am going to do something foolish and shameful!"

units.source_text: 正在忧愁之时，右近走过来，说道：“大将的信为什么退了回去？

en.t: As she was grieving, Ukon came over and said, "Why did you send the General's letter back?

units.source_text: 退回信件是不吉祥的啊！”

en.t: It is unlucky to return a letter!"

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我看见信中言语怪僻，不能理解，想是送错了人，所以退了回去。”

en.t: Ukifune answered, "The words in the letter seemed strange and I could not understand them, so I thought it had been sent to the wrong person and returned it."

units.source_text: 原来右近看出事有蹊跷，拿出去交付使者时已在途中打开信来看过了。

en.t: In fact, Ukon had sensed that something was wrong, and while taking the letter out to give to the messenger, she had already opened it on the way and read it.
It was truly wrong of Ukon to do this.

units.source_text: 她并不表示已经看过那信，说道：“啊呀，怎么办呢！

en.t: Without letting on that she had already read the letter, she said, "Oh dear, what are we to do!

units.source_text: 这事情叫大家都很痛苦！

en.t: This matter is causing everyone such distress!

units.source_text: 大将似乎已经听到消息了。”

en.t: The General seems to have heard the news already."

units.source_text: 浮舟听了顿时红晕满颊，一句话也说不出来。

en.t: When Ukifune heard this, her cheeks flushed at once, and she could not say a single word.

units.source_text: 她没想到右近已经看过那信，以为是另有知道薰大将情况的人告诉她，但也并不问她是从谁那里听来的。

en.t: She did not imagine that Ukon had already read the letter, and thought instead that someone else who knew about Kaoru had told her, but she did not ask whom she had heard it from.

units.source_text: 她想：“这些侍女看到我这光景，不知作何感想？

en.t: She thought, "Seeing me in this state, what must these ladies-in-waiting be thinking?

units.source_text: 虽然原是自作自受，我的命运也太苦了。”

en.t: Though I brought this upon myself, my fate is far too bitter."

units.source_text: 她不堪其忧，便躺卧下来。

en.t: Unable to bear her sorrow, she lay down.
